annotation.bound_parties_text: The plan assigns tasks to concerned ministries and central state administration authorities, notably ODPMII and its Directorate General for Digital Agenda, which must adjust structures and implement measures.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: Concerned ministries and other central state administration authorities will adjust their own structures in order to support meeting prioritized areas of the Action Plan
annotation.dates_quote: measures whose implementation can be started in the short-time horizon, i.e. from Q3 2019 until the end of 2022.
